ORDER BY manufacturer ASC
ORDER BY manufacturer DESC
ORDER BY name ASC
ORDER BY name DESC
ORDER BY transport_category ASC

ORDER BY lap_time DESC
ORDER BY top_speed ASC
ORDER BY top_speed DESC
ORDER BY price ASC
ORDER BY price DESC
ORDER BY release_date ASC
ORDER BY release_date DESC
ORDER BY manufacturer ASC, transport_category ASC, name ASC
